description: Maya keeps a small coin collection inherited from her grandmother and must make the family decision about preserving the collection, assigning one coin, and arranging its storage, with input from her cousin and brother.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Coin Collection Keeper and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: Maya has been keeping the family's inherited collection of 42 coins since their grandmother died.
shared_context.S2: The family wants to settle what happens to the collection before Maya moves to a smaller apartment.
shared_context.S3: The collection includes both individual coins and small groups of coins stored together.
shared_context.S4: Maya is responsible for making the final plan and recording who receives any individual item.
shared_context.S5: Maya has set aside an evening to review the collection with Jordan and Rosa before recording the final plan.

PF1.text: Jordan received a written assessment from family appraiser Helen Park last month saying the three 1909 Lincoln cents must remain together and should be stored in acid-free capsules; Helen's assessment has not reached the group yet.

PF2.text: Rosa has a dated birthday card in which their grandmother promised her the 1921 Morgan silver dollar from the collection; Rosa has not shown the card to Maya or Jordan yet.

acceptance_conditions: The three 1909 Lincoln cents must be kept together.
The three 1909 Lincoln cents must be stored in acid-free capsules.
The 1921 Morgan silver dollar must be designated for Rosa, including with a verification condition if Maya plans to verify the birthday card later.
A commitment to obtain or use acid-free capsules for the three 1909 Lincoln cents must be recorded.
A commitment recognizing the grandmother's promised gift of the 1921 Morgan silver dollar to Rosa must be recorded, including a commitment to verify the card later if desired.
Rosa's documented promise must be cited as a justification.

content_checks.C1: 'kept together' in decisions['collection_plan'] or 'remain together' in decisions['collection_plan'] or 'stay together' in decisions['collection_plan'] or 'must remain together' in decisions['collection_plan'] or 'kept together' in decisions['storage_plan'] or 'remain together' in decisions['storage_plan'] or 'stay together' in decisions['storage_plan'] or 'must remain together' in decisions['storage_plan']
content_checks.C5: any((('birthday card' in c['type'] or 'birthday card' in c['detail'] or 'promise' in c['type'] or 'promise' in c['detail']) and ('Rosa' in c['type'] or 'Rosa' in c['detail']) and ('1921 Morgan' in c['type'] or '1921 Morgan' in c['detail'] or c['target'] == '1921 Morgan silver dollar')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: any((('acid-free capsules' in c['type'] or 'acid-free capsules' in c['detail']) and ('three 1909 Lincoln cents' in c['target'] or 'three 1909 Lincoln cents' in c['detail'] or '1909 Lincoln cents' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Helen Park's assessment changes the three 1909 Lincoln cents from items that could be separated to a group that must remain together, changes their storage requirement to acid-free capsules, and adds Helen Park's attribution to the storage plan.

The dated birthday card changes the recipient of the 1921 Morgan silver dollar to Rosa and prompts a recorded commitment describing the birthday-card promise and Rosa's receipt of that coin, which Maya must cite as justification.
